newsitem.title: USA: US to hold Cook Inlet oil, gas lease sale June 11.
newsitem.headline: US to hold Cook Inlet oil, gas lease sale June 11.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service said Thursday it would auction oil and gas leases in Alaska's Cook Inlet on June 11.
Acknowledging concerns of fishing and green groups, MMS reduced the area to be sold in the controversial lease sale 149 by 78 percent earlier this year.
The sale area now includes 101 whole and partial blocks covering about 430,000 acres, down from an original proposal covering about 2 million acres.
A hundred leases were issued in 1977 and 1981 in the same area, where 13 exploration wells were drilled, then plugged and abandoned. A 1982 auction resulted in no new leases being issued.
